question: A 29-year-old woman presents with a skin rash that has spread on her arm over the last few days. She also complains of fever, headache, joint pain, and stiffness of the neck associated with the onset of the rash. On physical examination, there is an annular, red rash with a clear area in the center similar to a bull’s-eye (see image). The patient says she went on a camping trip to Connecticut last month but does not remember being bitten by an insect. Which of the following could result if this condition remains untreated in this patient?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Annular red rash with clear center" -> "suggestive of erythema migrans" -> "associated with Lyme disease" -> "untreated Lyme disease can lead to neurological complications" -> "possible development of Bell's palsy" -> 85%

CHAIN: "Annular red rash with clear center" -> "indicates possible Lyme disease" -> "Lyme disease can cause joint pain and stiffness" -> "if untreated, can lead to chronic arthritis" -> "not directly related to necrotizing fasciitis" -> 70%

CHAIN: "Annular red rash with clear center" -> "suggestive of Lyme disease" -> "can cause neurological symptoms" -> "untreated Lyme disease may lead to encephalitis" -> "not directly related to subacute sclerosing panencephalitis" -> 75%
CHAIN: "Annular red rash with clear center" -> "indicative of Lyme disease" -> "can affect the heart" -> "may lead to Lyme carditis" -> "not related to mitral valve prolapse" -> 80%

CHAIN: "Annular red rash with clear center" -> "suggestive of Lyme disease" -> "can cause various systemic symptoms" -> "untreated Lyme disease can lead to serious complications" -> "but not typically necrotizing fasciitis" -> 60%
analysis: The patient's symptoms and history suggest Lyme disease, which is characterized by a bull's-eye rash (erythema migrans) and can lead to various complications if untreated. One of the known complications of untreated Lyme disease is Bell's palsy, which is a form of facial paralysis that can occur due to the infection affecting the facial nerve. The other options listed do not have a direct association with Lyme disease. Therefore, the most likely result of untreated Lyme disease in this patient is Bell's palsy.
